source: ICRA'13 Sec. VI-A (numbers repeated in TOR'16 Sec. VI-B)
legal_moves_computed: transfer-matrix count of vertex-disjoint directed cycle sets (no 2-cycles) in the full grid; identical for every state of the fully occupied N^2-puzzle; brute force agrees for <= 4x4

claims.16-puzzle bidirectional search depth 3 s: about 5 x 10^8 states, 64 bits each (TOR: 'over 4 GB raw memory')

finding: ICRA/TOR: '16-puzzle ... the branching factor is over 1000 per step' is false: every 16-puzzle state has exactly 951 legal joint moves (950 excluding the all-stay move). The 36-puzzle claim 'well over 10^6' holds (4.19e7).
